tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search over Metastate's live property portfolio in Portugal and its guides (INE house prices, purchase costs, buying as a foreigner). Returns ids, titles and canonical URLs; use fetch with an id for the full content. Standard search/fetch interface for ChatGPT deep research. Example argume

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full content of a search result by id (property listing details or guide text), with its canonical URL for citation. Example arguments: {"id":"guia:custos"}

tools.name: pesquisar_imoveis
tools.description: Search available homes and commercial properties in Metastate's live portfolio in Portugal (Lisbon, Cascais, Sintra, Oeiras…), for sale or rent. Returns reference, title, operation, price (or monthly rent), type, size, area and listing link. / Procura imóveis disponíveis na carteira da Metastate, pa

tools.name: ver_imovel
tools.description: Full details of one Metastate property by reference (e.g. META-003) or slug: price, size, rooms, energy class, features, description, consultant and link. / Ficha completa de um imóvel pela referência ou slug. Example arguments: {"referencia":"META-003"}

tools.name: calcular_custos_compra
tools.description: Calculates the taxes and fees of buying a home in mainland Portugal with the official 2026 rates: IMT transfer tax (primary residence, second home, or under-35 exemption), stamp duty 0.8% and land registry (Casa Pronta). / Calcula IMT, imposto do selo e registo com as tabelas de 2026. Example argume

tools.name: consultar_precos_mercado
tools.description: Official median sale price per m² of homes sold, from Statistics Portugal (INE), for Lisbon, Cascais, Oeiras, Lisbon parishes and Portugal, plus buyer-origin and new-vs-existing splits. / Preço mediano por m² das casas vendidas, segundo o INE. Example arguments: {"zona":"Cascais"}

tools.name: consultar_guia_estrangeiro
tools.description: Step-by-step guide for foreigners buying property in Portugal: NIF tax number, bank account, promissory contract (CPCV), taxes, deed, and the current Golden Visa rules (real estate no longer qualifies since Law 56/2023). / Passos para um estrangeiro comprar casa em Portugal. Example arguments: {"idi

tools.name: marcar_visita
tools.description: Registers a viewing request for a property. The property's consultant contacts the user to confirm date and time (the viewing is not confirmed automatically). / Regista um pedido de visita; o consultor confirma com o cliente. Example arguments: {"referencia":"META-003","nome":"Ana Exemplo","telefone

tools.name: pedir_avaliacao
tools.description: Indicative sale value range for a property in Portugal from comparable listings in Metastate's portfolio, and a follow-up from a consultant for a full valuation with a visit. / Estimativa de valor e contacto de um consultor. Example arguments: {"zona":"Sintra","area_m2":120,"tipologia":"T3","estado"

tools.name: falar_com_consultor
tools.description: Leaves a contact request for a Metastate consultant (buy, sell, rent or other), in Portuguese, English, Spanish or French. / Deixa um pedido de contacto para um consultor. Example arguments: {"nome":"Agência Exemplo","email":"parcerias@example.com","interesse":"outro","mensagem":"We have a buyer for

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: marcar_visita, falar_com_consultor · Public sink: falar_com_consultor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: marcar_visita, falar_com_consultor · Public sink: falar_com_consultor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
